attributes.name: FileNodeDataSchema
attributes.initialValue:
z.object({
  type: z.literal(NodeType.FILE),
  path: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  extension: z.string(),
  linesOfCode: z.number().int().min(0),
  lastModified: z.number().int(),
  contentHash: z.string()
})
